summary: https://www.jvt.me This is awesome! IndieNews is our aggregator but I wouldn't add u-syndication to post templates...add it post-hoc if you think it qualifies as news. I post so much I usually don't syndicate to news unless someone in chat suggests I should.

body_html:
https://www.jvt.me This is awesome! IndieNews is our aggregator but I wouldn't add u-syndication to post templates...add it post-hoc if you think it qualifies as news.
I post so much I usually don't syndicate to news unless someone in chat suggests I should.
